MaxTextureResolution.Name: Max Map Texture Edge (px)
MaxTextureResolution.Hint: Flag scene backgrounds, foregrounds, and tiles whose width or height exceeds this pixel threshold.

MaxMegapixels.Name: Max Map Megapixels (MP)
MaxMegapixels.Hint: Flag map textures exceeding this megapixel budget (width × height / 1,000,000).

MaxWalls.Name: Max Walls per Scene
MaxWalls.Hint: Flag scenes with more wall segments than this threshold.

MaxLights.Name: Max Lights per Scene
MaxLights.Hint: Flag scenes with more ambient light sources than this threshold.

MaxAnimations.Name: Max Animations per Scene
MaxAnimations.Hint: Flag scenes whose animated lights, video tiles, animated tokens, and weather exceed this threshold.

MaxSettingBytes.Name: Bloated World Setting Threshold (bytes)
MaxSettingBytes.Hint: Flag world settings larger than this UTF-8 JSON byte size.

MaxFlagBytes.Name: Bloated Flag Namespace Threshold (bytes)
MaxFlagBytes.Hint: Flag document flag namespaces larger than this UTF-8 JSON byte size.

WebpQuality.Name: WebP Conversion Quality
WebpQuality.Hint: Quality factor (0.50–1.00) used when auto-converting heavy PNG/raster textures to WebP.

DownscaleOnConvert.Name: Downscale Oversized Maps on WebP Convert
DownscaleOnConvert.Hint: When enabled, converting an image larger than the max resolution threshold scales it down proportionally.

IncludeChatMessages.Name: Scan Chat Messages for Orphaned Flags
IncludeChatMessages.Hint: Include game.messages when scanning for orphaned module flags (may take longer in huge worlds).

MaxAssetBytes.Name: Max Texture File Size (bytes)
MaxAssetBytes.Hint: Flag scene/tile textures whose HTTP file size exceeds this byte limit.

NearDuplicateWallTolerance.Name: Near-Duplicate Wall Snap Tolerance (px)
NearDuplicateWallTolerance.Hint: Flag matching walls whose endpoints differ by at most this pixel distance (0 disables).

SkipLargerWebp.Name: Skip WebP Upload If Larger Than Original
SkipLargerWebp.Hint: When not downscaling, skip replacing an image if the re-encoded WebP is larger than the source file.

UuidMinAutoConfidence.Name: Minimum Confidence for Batch @UUID Replace
UuidMinAutoConfidence.Hint: Minimum candidate match score (0.75–1.00) included in batch @UUID replacement.

MaxChatMessages.Name: Chat Log Warning Threshold (messages)
MaxChatMessages.Hint: Flag the world chat log when total stored messages exceed this count.

Theme.Name: WAIFU Window Theme
Theme.Hint: Visual theme for the WAIFU audit window.

Accent.Name: WAIFU Accent Color
Accent.Hint: Accent palette for highlights and focus indicators.

Theme.ContrastHint: All 6 accents meet WCAG AA >= 4.5:1 across Night and Parchment.
